script: Broward, meet your next men’s pro team. Fort Lauderdale United joins USL League One in spring twenty twenty-seven. They’ll play at Amerant Bank Field in Davie. The women already play there, so you can get to know the club now. Who’s coming with you?
spokenStyle: A friend with one useful local update. Direct first sentence, connected explanation, a natural question at the end. Conversational Chris delivery; no sales voice or attribution filler.
